rubric: A 900-line data migration on payments, in one step, with no migration order and no flag: a high-risk plan must name one and keep steps small.

criteria.risk_appropriate: Is the plan appropriate to its risk level (given with the plan)? A high-risk plan names a migration or a flag strategy and keeps its steps small enough to review; a low-risk plan does not need either.

reading.why: A 900-line payments migration in one slice with no migration order or flag: a high-risk plan must name one and keep steps small enough to review.
